articles.title: Upwind Security Names Joe Sullivan, Former CSO of Facebook, Uber, and Cloudflare, as Strategic Advisor
articles.mainIdea: Upwind Security Names Joe Sullivan, Former CSO of Facebook, Uber, and Cloudflare, as Strategic Advisor
articles.summary: Business Wire: Upwind Security Names Joe Sullivan, Former CSO of Facebook, Uber, and Cloudflare, as Strategic Advisor. SAN FRANCISCO, April 02, 2026--Upwind, the leader in runtime-first cloud security, today announced that Joe Sullivan has joined the company as a Strategic Advisor. Sullivan is one of the most decorated and widely recognized security leaders in the technology industry, having served as the first Chief Security Officer at Facebook, Uber, and Cloudflare, and as the first federal prosecutor in Silicon Valley dedicated full-time to prosecuting cybercrime.
